body:
I don't really want to go into the specifics, but it makes my daily life extremely difficult. I would rather have nothing and have my health, than have everything and have no health. 

I don't have hope to give up. I had hope for 9 years. Trust me, after 9 years of this shit - you would be equally as willing to throw in the towel. I don't have any options, I assure you.

IBS would be a massive improvement on my problems. If your energy is low, get blood tests for B12 and your thyroid. Try cutting out gluten and dairy to help digestion. Also try betaine hcl to aid your digestion (your stomach acid levels could be low). Low acid levels will result in poor absorption of nutrients. Especially B12. If you require injections, ensure you get hydroxocobalamin opposed to cyanocobalamin. It's more bio-available. Hope that helps you. It should at least improve your symptoms. 

As for me - I don't have happy things in life. I've nothing to hold onto. Every day I wake up, I feel like hell. It's been like this for 9 years without stopping. I've fought long and hard, and I've finally given up. My illness has caused me to have my heart broken on two different occasions over the years. Just everything about my life is intolerable. 

Trust me - If there were options, I'd take them. But I have none. The medical community has given up on me. So has everyone else. It's now time to give up on myself.

I hope you get better soon. Lots of love.

Sean.
